description: This file contains shell functions related to controlling and managing the status LED on a device, including functions to determine the current status LED and set its state based on different system events.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and sets the current status LED based on the device's sysfs entries, prioritizing non-amber/red LEDs.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the provided argument, calling specific functions to blink or turn on the LED.
